_comment_DistanceScaling: This setting controls what % range of your simulation distance is considered close and far range
_comment_AIOptimizationType: This settings controls how aggressive the optimizations should be
_comment_TemptDelay: This setting controls how much delay animals have to being tempted by an item
_comment_DisableZombieEggStomping: This setting controls the prevention of zombies wanting to destroy turtle eggs
_comment_EnableVanillaMobTicking: This setting controls if distant mobs should tick the same as in a unmodded (vanilla) game. Enabling this reduces the mod's TPS-boosting effect on your game, but can fix mob ticking issues.
